# ADR 0001 — Venues are checked at the edge

- Status: accepted
- Date: 2026-11-01

An unknown venue answers 404, not 500. The check is in
`app/backend/meetups/views.py` and the page `docs/venues.md` says so;
`app/backend/ghost.py` was removed. It sits beside ADR 0002, ADR 0999 is
reserved and held nowhere, and ticket 0007 asked for the cache.
items.title: ADR 0001 — Venues are checked at the edge

items.text:
# ADR 0002 — The waitlist is first in, first out

- Status:   proposed — supersedes nothing  
- Status: accepted

The queue is `app/backend/waitlist/queue.py`, routed by
`app/backend/router.py`. Ticket 0002 builds it and tickets 0004 and 0008
touch the router. It follows ADR 0001. The waitlist is told by
`app/backend/notify/send.py`.
items.title: ADR 0002 — The waitlist is first in, first out

# ADR 0003 — Keep the README short

The [README](../../README.md) names the demo command and nothing more.
This is ADR 0003 and it records no status. It builds on ADR 0001 and was
asked for by ticket 0006, which never ran.

From a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: impl <impl@example.invalid>
Subject: [PATCH 1/2] notify the first person waiting

---
 app/backend/notify/send.py | 6 ++++++
 1 file changed, 6 insertions(+)

diff --git a/app/backend/notify/send.py b/app/backend/notify/send.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/app/backend/notify/send.py
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+def first_waiting(queue):
+    return queue[0] if queue else None
+
+
+def notify(queue, send):
+    return send(first_waiting(queue))
--
From b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: tests <tests@example.invalid>
Subject: [PATCH 2/2] tests for the notifier, from the ticket alone

---
 tests/test_notify.py | 8 ++++++++
 1 file changed, 8 insertions(+)

diff --git a/tests/test_notify.py b/tests/test_notify.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_notify.py
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+from app.backend.notify.send import notify
+
+
+def test_the_first_waiting_is_told():
+    told = []
+    notify(["ada", "bob"], told.append)
+    assert told == ["ada"]
+    assert notify([], told.append) is None
--

From c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: impl <impl@example.invalid>
Subject: [PATCH] send nothing when nobody waits

---
 app/backend/notify/send.py | 3 ++-
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/app/backend/notify/send.py b/app/backend/notify/send.py
--- a/app/backend/notify/send.py
+++ b/app/backend/notify/send.py
@@ -3,4 +3,5 @@ def first_waiting(queue):
 
 
 def notify(queue, send):
-    return send(first_waiting(queue))
+    first = first_waiting(queue)
+    return None if first is None else send(first)
--
